-- CONFIG\
local POOL = { \"MIG-21\", \"MIG-23\", \"MIG-31\", \"MIG-29\", \"MIRAGE-F1\", \"SU-27\" }\
local RESPAWN_DELAY  = 20   -- seconds after a group is destroyed\
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 5    -- how often to check if current group is dead\
local ALLOW_REUSE    = true -- true = keep reusing names forever; false = use each once then stop\
\
-- STATE\
local currentName = nil\
local available   = {}\
\
-- helpers\
local function refill()\
  available = {}\
  for i=1,#POOL do available[#available+1] = POOL[i] end\
end\
\
local function pickName()\
  if #available == 0 then\
    if not ALLOW_REUSE then\
      trigger.action.outText(\"No more REDFOR groups available.\", 10)\
      return nil\
    end\
    refill()\
  end\
  local idx = math.random(1, #available)\
  local name = available[idx]\
  table.remove(available, idx)\
  return name\
end\
\
local function aliveCount(grp)\
  if not grp or not grp:isExist() then return 0 end\
  local units, alive = grp:getUnits(), 0\
  for i=1,#units do\
    local u = units[i]\
    if u and u:isExist() and u:getLife() > 0 then alive = alive + 1 end\
  end\
  return alive\
end\
\
local function monitorCurrent()\
  if not currentName then return end\
  local grp = Group.getByName(currentName)\
  if aliveCount(grp) <= 0 then\
    trigger.action.outText(currentName..\" destroyed. New CAP in \"..RESPAWN_DELAY..\"s.\", 10)\
    currentName = nil\
    timer.scheduleFunction(function()\
      local name = pickName(); if not name then return end\
      local g = Group.getByName(name)\
      if g then\
        trigger.action.activateGroup(g)\
        currentName = name\
        trigger.action.outText(\"Activated REDFOR: \"..currentName, 10)\
        timer.scheduleFunction(monitorCurrent, nil, timer.getTime() + CHECK_INTERVAL)\
      end\
    end, nil, timer.getTime() + RESPAWN_DELAY)\
  else\
    timer.scheduleFunction(monitorCurrent, nil, timer.getTime() + CHECK_INTERVAL)\
  end\
end\
\
local function startRandomCAP()\
  refill()\
  local name = pickName(); if not name then return end\
  local grp = Group.getByName(name)\
  if grp then\
    trigger.action.activateGroup(grp)  -- groups must be Late Activated in ME\
    currentName = name\
    trigger.action.outText(\"Activated REDFOR: \"..currentName, 10)\

a_do_script("-- CONFIG\
local POOL = { \"MIG-21\", \"MIG-23\", \"MIG-19\", \"MIG-29\" }\
local RESPAWN_DELAY = 20       -- seconds after group destroyed before next spawn\
local CHECK_INTERVAL = 5       -- seconds between “is it dead yet?” checks\
local ALLOW_REUSE = true       -- true = reuse names forever; false = use each once\
\
-- STATE\
local currentName = nil        -- name of currently active group\
local available = {}           -- working list (filled from POOL)\
\
-- utils\
local function copyPool()\
  available = {}\
  for i=1,#POOL do available[#available+1] = POOL[i] end\
end\
\
local function pickRandomName()\
  if #available == 0 then\
    if ALLOW_REUSE then\
      copyPool()\
    else\
      trigger.action.outText(\"No more REDFOR groups available.\", 10)\
      return nil\
    end\
  end\
  local idx = math.random(1, #available)\
  local name = available[idx]\
  table.remove(available, idx)\
  return name\
end\
\
local function groupAliveCount(grp)\
  if not grp or not grp:isExist() then return 0 end\
  local units = grp:getUnits()\
  local alive = 0\
  for i=1,#units do\
    local u = units[i]\
    if u and u:isExist() and u:getLife() > 0 then\
      alive = alive + 1\
    end\
  end\
  return alive\
end\
\
local function monitorCurrent()\
  if not currentName then return end\
  local grp = Group.getByName(currentName)\
  local alive = groupAliveCount(grp)\
  if alive <= 0 then\
    trigger.action.outText(currentName..\" destroyed. New CAP in \"..RESPAWN_DELAY..\"s.\", 10)\
    currentName = nil\
    timer.scheduleFunction(function()\
      -- spawn another after delay\
      local nxt = pickRandomName()\
      if not nxt then return end\
      local g = Group.getByName(nxt)\
      if g then\
        trigger.action.activateGroup(g)\
        currentName = nxt\
        trigger.action.outText(\"Activated REDFOR: \"..currentName, 10)\
        -- start monitoring again\
        timer.scheduleFunction(monitorCurrent, nil, timer.getTime() + CHECK_INTERVAL)\
      end\
    end, nil, timer.getTime() + RESPAWN_DELAY)\
  else\
    -- still alive; check again later\
    timer.scheduleFunction(monitorCurrent, nil, timer.getTime() + CHECK_INTERVAL)\
  end\
end\
\
local function startRandomCAP()\
  copyPool()\
  local name = pickRandomName()\
  if not name then return end\
  local grp = Group.getByName(name)\
  if grp then\
    trigger.action.activateGroup(grp)\
    currentName = name\

a_do_script("-- Таблица с правильным порядком точек\
local waypoints = {}\
for i = 1, 43 do\
    table.insert(waypoints, tostring(i))\
end\
\
local currentWaypointIndex = 1\
local playerUnitName = \"TF-51D Hans\"  -- Имя самолета игрока\
local missionStarted = false  -- Флаг старта миссии\
local missionComplete = false\
local startTime = nil  -- Время начала миссии\
\
-- Функция для установки флага при взлете и запуска таймера\
function checkTakeoff()\
    local unit = Unit.getByName(playerUnitName)\
    if unit and unit:inAir() and unit:getPoint().y > 100 and not missionStarted then\
        trigger.action.setUserFlag(1500, true)\
        missionStarted = true\
        startTime = timer.getAbsTime()  -- Запоминаем абсолютное время старта\
    end\
    timer.scheduleFunction(checkTakeoff, nil, timer.getTime() + 1)\
end\
\
-- Функция для проверки пересечения зоны\
function checkWaypoint(unit, zoneName)\
    if currentWaypointIndex > #waypoints then return end  -- Если все точки пройдены, ничего не делаем\
    \
    if waypoints[currentWaypointIndex] == zoneName then\
        trigger.action.outText(\"Waypoint \" .. zoneName .. \" reached!\", 10)\
        currentWaypointIndex = currentWaypointIndex + 1  -- Переход к следующей точке\
    end\
end\
\
-- Функция форматирования времени\
function formatTime(timeElapsed)\
    local hours = math.floor(timeElapsed / 3600)\
    local minutes = math.floor((timeElapsed % 3600) / 60)\
    local seconds = math.floor(timeElapsed % 60)\
    local milliseconds = math.floor((timeElapsed * 100) % 100)\
    return string.format(\"%02d:%02d:%02d:%02d\", hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds)\
end\
\
-- Функция для проверки приземления и вывода результатов\
function checkLanding()\
    local unit = Unit.getByName(playerUnitName)\
    if unit and unit:inAir() == false and missionComplete == false and missionStarted then\
        local scoringZone = trigger.misc.getZone(\"scoring\")\
        if scoringZone then\
            local unitPos = unit:getPoint()\
            local distance = ((unitPos.x - scoringZone.point.x)^2 + (unitPos.z - scoringZone.point.z)^2)^0.5\
            if distance < scoringZone.radius then\
                if currentWaypointIndex > #waypoints then\
                    local totalTime = timer.getAbsTime() - startTime  -- Используем абсолютное время\
                    local formattedTime = formatTime(totalTime)\
                    trigger.action.outText(\"Mission Complete! Time: \" .. formattedTime, 10)\
                else\
                    trigger.action.outText(\"Mission Failed! Some waypoints were missed.\", 10)\
                end\
            end\
        end\
        missionComplete = true  -- Флаг, чтобы не срабатывать повторно\
    end\
end\
\
-- Таймеры для периодической проверки точек\
function monitorWaypoints()\
    local unit = Unit.getByName(playerUnitName)\
    if not unit then return end\
    \
    for _, zoneName in ipairs(waypoints) do\
        local zone = trigger.misc.getZone(zoneName)\
        if zone then\
            local unitPos = unit:getPoint()\
            local distance = ((unitPos.x - zone.point.x)^2 + (unitPos.z - zone.point.z)^2)^0.5\
            if distance < zone.radius then\
                checkWaypoint(unit, zoneName)\
            end\
        end\
    end\
    \
    -- Запускаем проверку снова через 1 секунду\
    timer.scheduleFunction(monitorWaypoints, nil, timer.getTime() + 1)\
end\
\
-- Запускаем мониторинг точек после старта миссии\
monitorWaypoints()\
\
-- Проверка посадки\
function monitorLanding()\
    checkLanding()\
    timer.scheduleFunction(monitorLanding, nil, timer.getTime() + 2)\
end\
monitorLanding()\
\
-- Запускаем проверку взлета\
checkTakeoff()\
")
